doc_title_en: Initiatives toward realizing management focused on capital cost and share price (including repositioning of long-term vision)
doc_title_jp: 資本コストや株価を意識した経営の実現に向けた取り組みについて

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本コストや株価を意識した経営の実現と長期ビジョンE・J-Vision2030の位置づけ更新

summary_en: Company shifts from fixed 2030 numerical targets to capital-efficiency and value-creation metrics. Maintains ROE target above 9% and capital cost spread of +3–5%, targeting PBR improvement from current 0.7–0.9x. Six integrated capitals (financial, human, intellectual, manufacturing, social/relational, natural) to be optimized cyclically to exceed cost of capital.
summary_jp: 2030年固定数値目標から資本効率・価値創造指標へ転換。ROE 9%以上、資本コスト超過3～5%維持。PBR現況0.7～0.9倍を改善。6資本統合最適化で資本コスト超過リターン創出。
tag_en: COC Update – Capital efficiency focus, ROE target maintained, PBR improvement priority, effective FY2026
tag_jp: COC更新 – 資本効率重視、ROE目標維持、PBR改善を優先、FY2026年度開始

summary_en: FY5/27 dividend: ¥82/share (¥72 ordinary + ¥10 anniversary special). Mid-term ¥30/share (¥25 ordinary + ¥5 special); year-end ¥52/share (¥47 ordinary + ¥5 special). Marks 20th anniversary from May 2007 founding. Mid-term distribution subject to board; year-end subject to annual shareholder meeting.
summary_jp: FY5/27通期配当：1株82円（普通配当72円＋記念配当10円）。中間30円（普通25円＋記念5円）、期末52円（普通47円＋記念5円）。2007年5月設立20周年を記念。中間配当は取締役会付議、期末配当は定時株主総会付議予定。
